record.question: What is the principle behind Alcian Blue staining?
options: Ionic bonds between cationic dye and anionic mucin
record.explanation: Answer C: Ionic bonds between cationic dye and anionic mucin. Alcian blue is a cationic copper phthalocyanine dye that binds anionic acidic mucosubstances through electrostatic interactions. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557663/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
